summary: CI runner credential reprovisioning after automated secret rotation blocked release pipeline
description:
Issue summary: After the nightly secrets-rotation job ran (vault-rotate-cron), our self-hosted GitLab runners lost access to the secrets path used by release pipelines. Impact: Release pipelines for multiple services stalled/failed, blocking a planned hotfix rollout.

Request: Help reprovision runner credentials, verify rotation tooling, and schedule a safe window for re-rotation.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger release pipeline for service 'inference-gateway' on main: job 'prepare-release' attempts to read /secret/ci/runners/inference-gateway and fails with 403.
Check runner logs (runner-01): repeated 403 from Vault API when fetching token, stack trace shows 'permission denied: token role mismatch'.
Inspect vault rotation job: vault-rotate-cron reported success but Vault audit shows token revocation events for 'ci-runner-role' at the same timestamp.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: rotation job revoked long-lived runner tokens without writing updated credentials to runners.

Found that kube secret 'ci-runner-creds' was updated but runners use projected service account tokens; the rotation job changed role binding on Vault side but did not update k8s service account annotations.
Observed GitLab Runner registration token still valid, but Vault policy now denies 'read' to the previous secret path; runners were not reprovisioned.
Related automation PR (infra#1427) added a Vault policy change last week; suspected to be mis-scoped change.
comments: [2026-03-11] Maya Kaur: Noticed multiple failed pipelines at 02:14 UTC after scheduled rotation. Creating this ticket to coordinate remediation and rollback if needed.
[2026-03-11] Jamal Rivera: Assigned. Sharing runner logs and Vault audit. Asking Infra to confirm last infra PRs that touched vault policies.
[2026-03-12] Priya Desai (Infra): Confirmed PR infra#1427 adjusted policy-to-role mapping. We see policy 'ci-runner-read' removed for 'ci-runner-role' at 02:12 UTC — looks accidental.
[2026-03-12] Jamal Rivera: As immediate mitigation, re-added policy binding and manually generated a short-lived token for runner-01; pipeline succeeded after we redeployed runner pod with new token.
[2026-03-13] Maya Kaur: Customer-facing release was paused; need timeline for full audit and permanent fix so rotation doesn't require manual steps.
resolution: Manual mitigation applied: restored Vault role binding and redeployed affected runners with short-lived tokens. Next steps: patch rotation job to update k8s SA annotations or rotate projected tokens, add Canary rotation test to CI, and schedule coordinated rotation window with Release Eng. Action items created in INT-9032 for automation fix.
